name: Libraries
description: Libraries word search puzzles gather shelf and quiet-reading English for adults — stack, catalog, browse, archive, carrel and calm room words — without publisher brands. Every puzzle is free in your browser with no download and no timer. Easy grids stay across and down; medium adds diagonals; hard uses all eight directions; large print keeps letters generous. The bank mixes short desk words such as due, hold and loan with longer anchors like reference, catalog and archive. This hub sits under Reading and pairs well with Journaling, Museums, History via American History and School for a wider study hour. Activity rooms and home readers both do well with large print. New to the site? Read how to play, then browse an easy aisle on the grid.
